payload.detail: #08216B was archived on 17 Oct with an outcome covering only the clinical-math calculators. Still open: src/app/api/proxy/route.ts (nothing calls it), scripts/recalculate-answer-support-labels.ts (no production caller; reassess it as a deletion candidate) and its test (covered by the normal test suite; do not treat it as unused), and the developer tool pages under src/app/mockups/development (unreachable duplicates of /admin/developer-hub) - remove after the 30-day dead-code window (13 Nov 2026) via npm run check:dead-code-candidate. The safe-number editor and clinical note editor are unwired: wire or remove each; the note editor needs a privacy review before any use (the attendance roster and QR check-in helper are wired through organise-sheets.tsx and teaching-code-sheet.tsx). The 16 Oct clinical-math calculator changes (IBW guidance, lithium boundaries, dose rounding) need clinician verification before any clinical use.
